workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've found a slot that works for everyone: Thursday at 14:30. Please go ahead and book the 30-minute meeting for then. I'll send the confirmation email after you've created the booking.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Great! I've booked the meeting for Thursday at 14:30. It's in the system now, so you can go ahead and send the confirmation email to the partners.
